title.narrative: UNDP - Green Energy Recovery Programme in Ukraine

description.narrative: The project, supported by Norad and UNDP, focuses on the critical repair and enhancement of Ukraine's energy infrastructure, particularly in Kharkiv. This includes designing emergency power supplies and procuring small gas turbines, gas engines, and solar panels to ensure the functionality of critical infrastructure. UNDP will provide extensive installation support and training for local actors, covering installation procedures, maintenance protocols, and troubleshooting techniques. Additionally, tailored training programs for local authorities will enhance their capacities in energy management, data management, analytical skills, and strategic planning. An awareness campaign will be launched to promote energy conservation and efficiency in the affected areas. Furthermore, an energy cluster will be established to coordinate emergency response efforts and mobilize resources for both immediate and long-term reconstruction. The overall goal is to ensure access to energy for the population in the target areas, significantly improving access to basic services such as heating, electricity, and water supply, especially for vulnerable groups including internally displaced persons and women.
